_about: Stage E.28 Part A lead rulings on the reading choices FactTable (OC-A3-1..11) and BlindScorer raised. Written by the lead 2026-10-21 15:13 PDT before any ranking output was read. Each applies uniformly; the return logs them as open choices OC-6..OC-10.

OC-A3-1_gate_unknown.ruling: MNG passes the 60-date gate by the same inference used for every other code (listed from 2023-11-06, 79 trade dates to 2024-02-29). Any other unknown gate stays excluded.

OC-A3-2_D_unknown.ruling: D with unknown R_d scores 1 (the spec's general unknown default, second-lowest score), not 0. Variant D_unknown_0 kept as a sensitivity.

OC-A3-3_E_unknown.ruling: Each s() component of E with an unknown mu scores 1 (so E = 1), not 0. Variant E_unknown_0 kept as a sensitivity.

OC-A3-4.ruling: accepted as FactTable wrote it (formed QV primary; QV_proxy_only variant shown).

OC-A3-6_jump_transfer.ruling: Big-move counts are a property of the underlying price, the same logic as OC-1: the C4_jump_transfer reading is PRIMARY (sibling counts apply to the OC-1 codes). The no-transfer reading is shown as a variant.

OC-A3-9.ruling: accepted (a 0-contract cap at 50K means not listed for the 50K plan).

OC-6_unverified_evidence.ruling: A C6 rating may not rest only on evidence known from an abstract or snippet ([unverified]) at either extreme: such evidence cannot set C6 = 0 (exclusion) or C6 >= 3. C25's C6 = 0 rests on an abstract-only preprint, so it is replaced by the level the remaining evidence supports (see OC-7). RankingReviewer checks every C6 >= 3 for the same defect.

OC-7_class_evidence.ruling: The spec's C6 level 2 is 'evidence only for futures or the asset class broadly'. The X39 order-book studies (Dixon 2017; the X39 OFI studies significant at one second) are futures-broad evidence, so every C6 rated 1 becomes 2 (BlindScorer's own cross-sheet note). C6 = 0 stays only where it rests on full-text negative evidence (none after OC-6).

BlindScorer_alternatives.ruling: The primary ratings stand for C07, C15 (alt 0 not used) and F04 (A = 2, the spec's 'borderline' anchor, not 0); C1(b) partial evidence stays as rated.
